groups.name: spring.datasource.security
groups.description: Security模块独立数据源配置（用户、角色、权限表）

groups.name: security.redis
groups.description: Security模块独立Redis配置，配置后将使用独立Redis连接

properties.name: spring.datasource.security.jdbc-url
properties.description: Security模块数据库JDBC连接URL，配置后将使用独立数据源

properties.name: spring.datasource.security.username
properties.description: Security模块数据库用户名

properties.name: spring.datasource.security.password
properties.description: Security模块数据库密码

properties.name: spring.datasource.security.driver-class-name
properties.description: 数据库驱动类名，默认自动检测（MySQL: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver）

properties.name: spring.datasource.security.maximum-pool-size
properties.description: 连接池最大连接数

properties.name: spring.datasource.security.minimum-idle
properties.description: 连接池最小空闲连接数

properties.name: spring.datasource.security.idle-timeout
properties.description: 空闲连接超时时间（毫秒），超过此时间空闲连接被释放

properties.name: spring.datasource.security.max-lifetime
properties.description: 连接最大生命周期（毫秒），超过此时间连接会被关闭并重建

properties.name: spring.datasource.security.connection-timeout
properties.description: 获取连接的最大等待时间（毫秒），超时将抛出异常

properties.name: spring.datasource.security.pool-name
properties.description: 连接池名称，用于监控和日志识别

properties.name: security.redis.host
properties.description: Security模块Redis主机地址，配置后将使用独立Redis

properties.name: security.redis.port
properties.description: Security模块Redis端口

properties.name: security.redis.password
properties.description: Security模块Redis密码

properties.name: security.redis.database
properties.description: Security模块Redis数据库索引

properties.name: security.redis.timeout
properties.description: Security模块Redis连接超时时间

properties.name: security.redis.lettuce.pool.max-active
properties.description: Lettuce连接池最大活跃连接数

properties.name: security.redis.lettuce.pool.max-idle
properties.description: Lettuce连接池最大空闲连接数

properties.name: security.redis.lettuce.pool.min-idle
properties.description: Lettuce连接池最小空闲连接数

properties.name: security.redis.lettuce.pool.max-wait
properties.description: Lettuce连接池获取连接最大等待时间

properties.name: security.redis.ssl.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用SSL连接

properties.name: security.redis.cluster.nodes
properties.description: Redis集群节点地址列表，格式：host:port

properties.name: security.redis.sentinel.master
properties.description: Redis哨兵模式主节点名称

properties.name: security.redis.sentinel.nodes
properties.description: Redis哨兵节点地址列表，格式：host:port
